```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(survey)
```


```{r}
anes_24 <- read_csv('~/Documents/GitHub/es32033-dissertation/data/anes/anes_timeseries_2024_csv_20260519.csv')
```


```{r}
#variables of interest for model
initial_vars <- c('V240001', 'V242095x', 'V241177', 'V241179', 'V241180', 'V241458x', 'V241465x', 'V241566x', 'V241567x', 'V241551', 'V242438', 'V242437', 'V242436') #main vars + controls

#rename for clarity according to codebook
anes_24_for_model <- anes_24 %>% rename(
  case_id = V240001, #unique identifier - for validation
  turnout = V242095x, # -2 = not reported
  libconself = V241177, # 1-7 scale
  libcondem = V241179, # as above
  libconrep = V241180, #as above
  age = V241458x, #-2 = NA, 80+ = 80 or older
  education_lvl = V241465x, # 1-5 scale
  income_total = V241566x, # 29 category variable - excludes PAPI respondents
  income_bracket = V241567x, # 1-6 scale
  gender = V241551, # 1 = man, 2 = woman
  leftrightself = V242438, # 0-10 scale
  leftrightdem = V242437, # 0-10 scale
  leftrightrep = V242436 # 0-10 scale
) %>%
  mutate(
    graduate = if_else(education_lvl == 4 | education_lvl == 5, 1, 0),
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c('Male', 'Female')),
    income_bracket = factor(income_bracket, levels = 1:6, labels = c('<9,999', '10-29,999', '30-59,999', '60-99,999', '100,000-249,999', '>250,000')))  
```


```{r}
# set up 'distance' variable
anes_24_final<- anes_24_for_model %>% 
  mutate(distance_from_dem_libcon = abs(libconself - libcondem),
         distance_from_rep_libcon = abs(libconself - libconrep),
         distance_from_closest = pmin(distance_from_dem_libcon, distance_from_rep_libcon),
         distance_from_furthest = pmax(distance_from_dem_libcon, distance_from_rep_libcon),
         equidist = if_else(distance_from_closest == distance_from_furthest, TRUE, FALSE),
         #vars for using the 0-10 rather than 1-7 scale

         distance_from_dem_lr = abs(leftrightself - leftrightdem),
         distance_from_rep_lr = abs(leftrightself - leftrightrep),
         distance_from_closest_alt = pmin(distance_from_dem_lr, distance_from_rep_lr),
         distance_from_furthest_alt = pmax(distance_from_dem_lr, distance_from_rep_lr)
         )
         

sprintf('%d voters report themselves as equidistant on the liberal - conservative scale', nrow(anes_24_filtered %>% filter(equidist == TRUE)))

```

```{r}
#setup survey weights as outlined in the codebook - for all post election respondents including PAPI
des <- svydesign(
  ids = ~V240107c,
  strata = ~V240107d,
  weights = ~V240107a,
  data = anes_24_final,
  nest = TRUE
)


#make sure that filtering for invalid responses doesn't distort the weighting by specifying the subset we're interested in
des_basic <- subset(des, turnout != -2 & between(libconself, 1, 7) & between(libcondem, 1, 7) & between(libconrep, 1, 7))

des_controls <- des %>% subset(age >= 18 & 
            turnout != -2 & 
            !is.na(gender) & 
            !is.na(income_bracket) &
            education_lvl > 0 &
            between(libconself, 1, 7) & between(libcondem, 1, 7) & between(libconrep, 1, 7))

#as above using the 0-10 rather than 1-7 scale
des_controls_alt <- des %>% subset(age >= 18 & 
                             turnout != -2 & 
                             !is.na(gender) & 
                             !is.na(income_bracket) & 
                             education_lvl > 0 &
                             between(leftrightself, 1, 10) & between(leftrightrep, 1, 10) & between(leftrightdem, 1, 10))
```


```{r}
#most basic lpm without controls 
basic_lpm <- svyglm(turnout ~ distance_from_closest + distance_from_furthest, design = des_basic)
summary(basic_lpm)

#lpm with controls as in rivas
full_lpm <- svyglm(turnout ~ distance_from_closest + distance_from_furthest + gender + graduate + income_bracket + age + I(age^2), design = des_controls)
summary(full_lpm)

#lpm with 0-10 rather than 1-7 scale
full_lpm_alt <- svyglm(turnout ~ distance_from_closest_alt + distance_from_furthest_alt + gender + graduate + income_bracket + age + I(age^2), design = des_controls_alt)
summary(full_lpm_alt)


```

```{r}
#version with validated voter turnout

anes_24_validation <- read_csv('~/Documents/GitHub/es32033-dissertation/data/anes/anes_timeseries_2024_csv_VoterValidation.csv') %>% select(V240001, val_turnout24) %>% rename(case_id = V240001)

```
```{r}
#create version with validation from voter records
anes_24_final_validated <- anes_24_final %>% left_join(anes_24_validation, join_by(case_id)) %>%
  mutate(validated = case_when(
    val_turnout24 == 4 & turnout == 1 ~ TRUE,
    val_turnout24 == 3 & turnout == 0 ~ TRUE,
    .default = FALSE
  ))


```

```{r}
#weighting for validated version using updated data (in final version do validation at start!)
des_val <- svydesign(
  ids = ~V240107c,
  strata = ~V240107d,
  weights = ~V240107a,
  data = anes_24_final_validated,
  nest = TRUE) %>% subset(age >= 18 & 
            turnout != -2 & 
            !is.na(gender) & 
            !is.na(income_bracket) & 
            education_lvl > 0 &
            validated == TRUE &
            between(libconself, 1, 7) & between(libcondem, 1, 7) & between(libconrep, 1, 7))

full_lpm_val <- svyglm(turnout ~ distance_from_closest + distance_from_furthest + gender + graduate + income_bracket + age + I(age^2), design = des_val)

summary(full_lpm_val)
```
